arguments.message: on the wash but shaft power well above sustainable for 75 s: decide hang_on or let_go

text: no cue: first minute, start effort not yet settled; watch added for costly wash effort

arguments.message: off the wash and the pod reserve runs out well before the finish
pod reserve down to a quarter while still on the wash: consider let_go and settle

text: no cue: alert came from the boat model, misled by the wash; pod effort only slightly above sustainable, reserve better spent on the wash for now

arguments.message: pod reserve down to a quarter: if still chasing the pack, let go and settle to own pace

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac < 0.15 and shaft_power_w > cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: pod reserve nearly empty while still above critical power: ease now

text: no cue: holding pack speed at steady effort with pod reserve 68 percent; reserve spent near the pack costs little, let go later before it runs low

arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady pace.

text: let_go: wash benefit has faded to nothing while shaft power sits well above sustainable; pod reserve would empty 4 km before the finish

arguments.text: Ease off now, let them go. Hold 2:39 pace.

text: ease to 2:39: still chasing with no wash benefit at 189 W, pod reserve 24 percent empties in about 550 m
no cue: an ease cue was just given about 30 s ago; give it time to take effect

arguments.text: A touch easier still. Hold 2:41, smooth and steady.

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac < 0.1 and shaft_power_w > cp_shaft_w + 8 and remaining_m > 700
arguments.message: pod reserve under a tenth and power clearly above critical power: ease

text: ease to 2:41: partial response, still 12 W above critical power with pod reserve 14 percent and 5 km to go

arguments.text: Ease back now. Hold 2:42 to save your finish.

text: ease to 2:42: previous ease did not take, 10 W over critical power with pod reserve 8 percent, empties in 500 m

arguments.text: Back right off now, you are on empty. Hold 2:43.

text: ease to 2:43: still 10 W over critical power after earlier ease cues, pod reserve 2 percent, blow-up imminent

arguments.message: speed well below what the shaft power gives for 20 s: tired blade work, consider ease or rate_down

text: no cue: an ease cue went out under 60 s ago; watching whether the speed drop is a blow-up or the turn

arguments.text: Drop the rate a little. Long, relaxed strokes, let it recover.

text: rate_down: pod reserve empty, fade jumped to 7 percent with speed well below what the shaft power gives; ease cues have not lowered power

arguments.text: Stop forcing it. Ease to 2:45 and let your body recover.
Stop forcing it. Ease to 2:45 and let your body recover.

text: ease to 2:45: pod reserve empty and still 17 W over critical power with a 6 percent fade; effort must drop below critical power to recover

arguments.text: Drop the rate two. Long, strong, relaxed strokes.

text: rate_down: a 7 percent fade has lasted 6 minutes at rate 66 with speed well below what the shaft power gives; a lower rate suits a tired paddler

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Hold 2:43 steady, save the sprint for the end.

text: ease to 2:43: after a forced slowdown the reserve refilled only to 6 percent and power is back 9 W over critical power; it would empty in 400 m

arguments.text: Just a little easier, 2:44. Sprint comes in the last 300.

arguments.message: 280 m to go: time for the final sprint

text: ease to 2:44: 6 W over critical power with the pod reserve at 2 percent and 1.7 km left; finish watch set at 280 m
no cue: an ease cue went out under a minute ago; give it time

arguments.text: Ease slightly and stay smooth, 2:49. Big finish from 300 out.

text: ease to 2:49: power back 12 W over critical power after another forced slowdown, pod reserve 5 percent would empty 800 m before the line
no cue: just through the turn and recovering from a forced slowdown with little reserve; sprint cue planned at 280 m

arguments.text: Go now! Empty the tank all the way to the line.

text: finish: 273 m to go, whatever reserve is left is best spent now
